fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Revue systématique selon PRISMA, avec un cadre SRPF complémentaire
fields.quote: This study adhered to the PRISMA guidelines for systematic literature review, including study identification, screening, eligibility assessment, and inclusion

fields.label: Modèles
fields.quote: In a direct comparison, GPT-4 achieved 13.4% precision in article screening versus 9.4% for GPT-3.5 (Chelli et al. 2024)

fields.label: Résultats
fields.value: Les modèles d'IA améliorent l'efficacité de 40 % et obtiennent une sensibilité de 80.6 % à 96.2 % en screening, mais la précision peut chuter à 4.6 % et les hallucinations atteindre 91 %.
fields.quote: AI models can substantially improve efficiency, with time savings of up to 40% across various review tasks. Accuracy was particularly strong in structured fields such as medical research, where title and abstract screening sensitivities ranged from 80.6% to 96.2%. However, performance declined in more interpretative contexts, with precision dropping as low as 4.6% and hallucination rates reaching 91%.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Risques de hallucinations pouvant inclure références fabriquées, citations erronées ou interprétations incorrectes, menaçant l'intégrité académique.
fields.quote: Hallucinated outputs can include fabricated references, misquoted findings, or incorrect interpretations, each of which poses a direct threat to the integrity of academic work (Fui-Hoon Nah et al. 2023).
